Zenodo_318_island_mammals.result: within-archipelago source information improved heldout log loss descriptively overall and in both regimes, but extreme-isolation amplification primary was unsupported

ecological_update.rejected_as_universal: Extreme mainland/continent isolation is not supported as a universal switch that amplifies the value of occupied insular source pools.
ecological_update.retained: Species-conditioned occupied source pools can contain heldout occurrence information beyond strong island-state and global occupancy-breadth references.
ecological_update.revised_interpretation: Source-pool relevance appears context-dependent rather than governed by remoteness alone; archipelago structure, taxon dispersal mode, history, or source saturation may determine when source-network information is strongest.

next_fresh_hypothesis_boundary.candidate_future_question: Does source-pool importance depend jointly on dispersal mode and archipelago permeability rather than monotonically on mainland isolation?
